request.spec: My client list is getting long. Give me a box to search for a client by name.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
My client list is getting long. Give me a box to search for a client by name.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes. Let me summarize the full-stack change I implemented for the "search clients by name" feature:

**Database** — `src/main/resources/db/migration/V6__client_name_search_index.sql`
New Flyway migration adding an index on `clients(name)` to keep name lookups fast as the list grows.

**Server** (OfficeFloor REST, additive):
- `ClientRepository` — added `findByNameContainingIgnoreCaseOrderByIdAsc(String)`.
- `ClientService` — added `search(q)`: returns all clients when `q` is blank, otherwise a case-insensitive name match.
- `ClientsLogic` — the `GET /api/clients` logic now accepts an optional `@HttpQueryParameter("q")` and delegates to `search(...)`.

**Front-end** — `src/main/frontend/features/clients/ClientsPage.tsx`
Added a `data-testid="client-search"` input above the existing list. Its value drives a reload of `/api/clients?q=<term>`, so the server filters by name; an empty box shows all clients. The existing `client-row-*`, `client-name`, etc. test anchors are untouched.

The change is additive and local to the clients feature — no shared router/UI edits, no pinned scaffolding touched. `bin/e2e` builds, starts the app, and the acceptance spec passes.
